description.zh: 直接连接 DSH 运行时的轻量快速终端界面插件。
description.en: A lightweight and fast terminal interface plugin connected directly to the DSH runtime.

description.zh: 在输入框统计行里、原生缓存命中读数之后显示计费时段与账户余额：高峰/非高峰圆点与切换倒计时，点击展开面板，按接口返回的货币拆分总额、赠送与充值。
description.en: Billing season and account balance in the composer statistics row, right after the cache-hit reading: a peak/off-peak dot with a countdown to the next switch, and a panel splitting the balance into total, granted and topped up in the currency the API reports.

description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 手机端：用手机远程接着聊、审批并管理电脑上的会话，支持中转隧道与局域网配对。注意：默认开启自动更新，约每 2 分钟从 npm 安装最新版且不经确认，目录固定的提交不约束实际运行的版本；默认公用中转（wnluo.com）由作者运营。尚未通过人工收录审核（#111）。
description.en: DeepSeek Harness mobile companion: continue chats, approve actions and manage desktop sessions from a phone, via a relay tunnel or LAN pairing. Note: auto-update is on by default and installs the latest npm release about every 2 minutes without confirmation, so the pinned commit does not bound the running version; the default public relay (wnluo.com) is operated by the author. Not yet approved in manual review (#111).
